# native-glass/win — Windows Glass implementation (glass.dll).
#
# All sources come from upstream OpenJFX's native-glass/win tree
# (copied via /jfx-master). They speak Win32 and Java JNI.
#
# Required: JNI (from JDK) and a set of Win32 system libs. The
# JNI headers for our Java classes are generated by javac -h
# during compileJava and exposed via OPENJFX_JNI_HEADERS_DIR.

if(NOT WIN32)
    return()
endif()

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(openjfx_glass LANGUAGES CXX)

find_package(JNI REQUIRED)

# Honor MSVC static runtime to match Skia (CMP0091 NEW set at top).
if(MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()

# Source list — explicit so CMake notices new files (no globs).
set(GLASS_SOURCES
    BaseWnd.cpp
    CommonDialogs.cpp
    CommonDialogs_COM.cpp
    CommonDialogs_Standard.cpp
    FullScreenWindow.cpp
    GlassAccessible.cpp
    GlassApplication.cpp
    GlassClipboard.cpp
    GlassCursor.cpp
    GlassDnD.cpp
    GlassInputTextInfo.cpp
    GlassMenu.cpp
    GlassScreen.cpp
    GlassTextRangeProvider.cpp
    GlassView.cpp
    GlassWindow.cpp
    custom/CustomWinProc.cpp
    KeyTable.cpp
    ManipulationEvents.cpp
    Pixels.cpp
    PlatformSupport.cpp
    RoActivationSupport.cpp
    Robot.cpp
    Timer.cpp
    Utils.cpp
    ViewContainer.cpp
    common.cpp
    GlassResources.rc
)

add_library(glass SHARED ${GLASS_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(glass PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
if(DEFINED OPENJFX_JNI_HEADERS_DIR)
    target_include_directories(glass PRIVATE ${OPENJFX_JNI_HEADERS_DIR})
endif()

# Resources include version.rc from the shared resources dir, which
# requires JFX_FVER / JFX_FNAME / JFX_INTERNAL_NAME defines.
set(_RESOURCES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../resources")
# All XSTR(...) consumers expect bareword tokens that the preprocessor
# stringifies — pass without quotes.
set_property(SOURCE GlassResources.rc APPEND PROPERTY
    COMPILE_OPTIONS
        "/I${_RESOURCES_DIR}"
        "/DJFX_FVER=25,0,0,0"
        "/DJFX_FTYPE=0x2L"
        "/DJFX_VER=25.0.0"
        "/DJFX_NAME=openjfx-skia"
        "/DJFX_COMPONENT=Glass"
        "/DJFX_COMPANY=openjfx-skia"
        "/DJFX_BUILD_ID=local"
        "/DJFX_COPYRIGHT=GPL"
        "/DJFX_FNAME=glass.dll"
        "/DJFX_INTERNAL_NAME=glass")

# UNICODE everywhere (Glass uses TCHAR / wide-char Win32 APIs).
# Do NOT define NOMINMAX — upstream Glass relies on Windows.h's
# min/max macros.
target_compile_definitions(glass PRIVATE
    UNICODE _UNICODE
    WIN32 _WIN32 _WINDOWS
)

# Glass code predates strict C++20 string-literal semantics. Build at
# C++17 and relax MSVC's strict-string check so the upstream sources
# compile unmodified.
set_target_properties(glass PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 14)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(glass PRIVATE
        /Zc:strictStrings-
        /D_HAS_AUTO_PTR_ETC=1   # keep std::auto_ptr (removed in C++17)
    )
endif()

# Win32 + UI Automation deps. Mirrors upstream win.gradle linkFlags
# but expressed as CMake target_link_libraries.
target_link_libraries(glass PRIVATE
    delayimp
    user32
    gdi32
    urlmon
    Comdlg32
    winmm
    imm32
    shell32
    ole32
    oleaut32
    UIAutomationCore
    dwmapi
    shlwapi
    version
    advapi32
    runtimeobject
)

# Delay-load DLLs that are version-sensitive or Win10+ only (mirror
# upstream's /DELAYLOAD list).
if(MSVC)
    foreach(dll user32 urlmon winmm shell32 UIAutomationCore dwmapi shlwapi version)
        target_link_options(glass PRIVATE "/DELAYLOAD:${dll}.dll")
    endforeach()
endif()

set_target_properties(glass PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME glass
    PREFIX ""    # no "lib" prefix — match JavaFX naming
)
